posts.title: Testing HLSL with the LLVM Offload Test Suite in WSL 2
posts.description: If you are a developer working with HLSL or GPU compilers you likely prefer working in Linux. You might have felt sidelined because Linux lacks a dedicated DirectX device. However, if you are on Windows, you have a powerful tool at your disposal: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) 2 .
